title: Loot

heroImage.alt: Blue faceted diamond-shaped sculpture on a black pedestal, viewed at an angle outdoors.

images.alt: Blue faceted sculpture and curved black pedestal shown from another angle outdoors.
Front view of the blue diamond-shaped sculpture on a black pedestal, with trees in the background.
Close view of the blue faceted sculpture and its black pedestal base.

description: Loot is a video game artifact brought to life in steel and paint. Its bold lines, saturated color, and exaggerated contours bring the familiar promise of treasure into the real world, turning a digital reward into a physical object worth pursuing.
